summary: This directory centralizes the definitions and types for individual document content components. It provides a standardized schema structure for various elements that can appear within a document, ensuring consistent data modeling across the application.
responsibilities: Define structural schemas for document content elements
Provide TypeScript type definitions for content structures
Expose unified interfaces for document content components
relationships: Each schema defines a specific type identifier and the corresponding content structure required for that element.
The index file aggregates multiple content definitions to provide a single entry point for importing document components.
designDecisions: Literal type identification for schema discrimination
Co-location of schema constants and TypeScript types
Barrel file export strategy for modular access
